tasks.short: Set audit scope, direct audit work, and resolve significant findings.

steps.what: Collect ledger summaries, prior findings, and control records.
Assess business changes, prior findings, and possible audit risks.

loop.input: Audit evidence pack and business change notes.
loop.output: Preliminary risk assessment with evidence references and unresolved questions.
loop.check: Validate references and figures; audit lead checks omissions and unsupported conclusions.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per section; unsupported sections return to the audit lead.
loop.why_not_simpler: Business change narratives and prior findings require contextual reading beyond numerical thresholds.

steps.what: Discuss operational changes, sensitive issues, and evidence gaps with process owners.
Decide materiality, audit coverage, escalation triggers, and investigation scope.
Assign audit procedures, evidence requests, reviewers, and deadlines.
Review workpapers, challenge findings, and authorize further investigation.
Copy workpaper progress into a separate audit status tracker.

tasks.design: An integration gathers an audit evidence pack from the {ERP} and {DOCS}; a bounded drafting loop prepares a referenced risk assessment. The {PROJECT} turns approved scope into assignments and live progress, removing the separate tracker. The audit lead retains scope, materiality, finding, and investigation decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence sits across records and documents, while scope depends on context and professional judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable connectors, templates, and small drafting loops reduce preparation costs; AI-assisted coding can shorten bespoke integration work.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence completeness, management challenge, auditor independence, and proportionate investigation remain difficult.
tasks.human_edge: Recognizing concealed risks, challenging explanations, and defending a proportionate audit scope.

ambition.what: Monthly reassessment of audit coverage after significant business changes.

tasks.altitude: The week contains less evidence gathering and status copying, with more time for difficult findings. The audit lead can propose interim scope changes, subject to the existing audit mandate.

reach.task: Maintain operational risk indicators that inform audit coverage.
reach.learn: Risk indicator design, threshold calibration, and the distinction between risk monitoring and independent assurance.

evidence.claim: Evidence extraction and tests of details can be supported while reviewers retain sign-off.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reported statement tick-and-tie falling from eight to two hours; this does not establish automated scope judgement.
Scope, materiality, and investigation decisions generally require professional judgement.

assumptions: The baseline represents an internal audit lead in a mid-size company; external audit governance may differ.
Time shares and remaining percentages are planning estimates informed by the supplied priors.
Build ranges cover one reusable audit workflow, not an enterprise assurance platform.
Access work includes GDPR review and employee consultation where national rules require it.
unknowns: The audit mandate and scope approval hierarchy.
Available evidence interfaces and document permissions.
Whether a separate status tracker actually duplicates existing records.
Whether planned data use involves employee monitoring.
research_questions: Which existing {PROJECT} features support dependencies, review sign-offs, and immutable history?
Which national rules apply if audit analytics monitor employee behaviour?
new_work: Review risk drafts for missing context and unsupported conclusions.
Resolve incomplete evidence packs and permission failures.
Maintain procedure templates and evidence mappings.
Periodically check whether coverage proposals overlook emerging risks.

tasks.short: Improve accounting records, controls, integrations, and supporting documentation.

steps.what: Document recordkeeping problems and agree the intended accounting outcome.
Specify account mappings, validation rules, approval limits, and reconciliation controls.
Configure record fields, posting validations, and approval routes in a test environment.
Build or modify imports, interfaces, and record transformations.
Run sample transactions and compare balances, permissions, and exception handling.
Validate accounting treatment and approve release readiness.
Deploy approved changes and check opening balances and live transactions.
Update operating instructions, field definitions, and change records.

tasks.design: Configure recordkeeping and controls in the {ERP} and {WORKFLOW} first, adding deterministic interfaces on the {DATA_PLATFORM} only for gaps. A versioned specification drives repeatable tests, deployment checks, and templated instructions in {DOCS}. Accounting acceptance and production release retain separate approval points.
tasks.previous_blocker: Small improvements competed with larger technical projects, and specifications, tests, and instructions were maintained separately.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding can reduce the effort of bounded interfaces and test harnesses; existing configuration handles many requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Accounting policy choices, legacy data quality, segregation of duties, migration, and production access.
tasks.human_edge: Turning accounting obligations into workable controls and deciding whether the resulting records faithfully represent transactions.

ambition.what: A finance control sandbox for testing proposed posting and approval changes before release.

tasks.altitude: The accountant spends more time designing controls and validating changes, with less manual test comparison and documentation. They gain the ability to run sandbox experiments; production approval rights require explicit delegation.

reach.task: Define governed financial datasets for management reporting.
reach.learn: Data modelling, lineage, stable metric definitions, and reconciliation to the ledger.

evidence.claim: Accounting validations, mappings, and reconciliations can use deterministic configuration and code.
AI-assisted development can reduce implementation effort, but no customer-specific acceleration is established here.
A documented procurement case replaced spreadsheet orders and chat approvals with a controlled workflow; it does not establish ledger implementation performance.

assumptions: The scope is one bounded accounting process change, not replacement of the {ERP}.
A test environment and supported interfaces exist.
The baseline includes specialist time coordinated by the accountant.
Remaining time reflects reusable configuration and AI-assisted engineering, not automatic generation of a correct accounting design.
Access estimates include GDPR review and consultation under national rules where changed controls affect employees.
unknowns: Existing configuration capabilities and interface restrictions.
Whether representative test data and a safe test environment exist.
The release authority and required segregation of duties.
The extent of historical data migration.
Employee consultation obligations for the proposed changes.
research_questions: Which requested controls can the existing {ERP} configure without extensions?
Which interface patterns support idempotency, rollback, and a complete audit trail?
new_work: Maintain versioned specifications and representative test cases.
Investigate failed reconciliations and interface retries.
Keep access roles, rollback procedures, and generated instructions current.

tasks.short: Advise managers on financial and regulatory issues and record agreed actions.

steps.what: Gather relevant balances, forecasts, policies, and previous decisions.
Calculate financial effects and compare practical options.
Prepare a briefing with implications, uncertainties, and questions for management.

loop.input: Checked option comparison, evidence pack, and dated approved regulatory guidance.
loop.output: Briefing with referenced figures, options, uncertainties, and questions.
loop.check: Tie figures to calculations; verify guidance references and applicability; accountant approves advice.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; missing or conflicting guidance returns to the accountant.
loop.why_not_simpler: Explaining a case-specific trade-off requires synthesis of narrative guidance and financial context.

steps.what: Discuss implications, challenge assumptions, and agree decisions with managers.
Record decisions, owners, deadlines, and any required formal approvals.
Send action reminders and collect progress updates.

tasks.design: A reusable briefing builder gathers evidence from the {ERP}, {BI}, and {DOCS}, calculates approved scenarios, and drafts a referenced discussion brief. Managers and the accountant conduct the discussion; structured decision notes generate an approved action log in the {PROJECT}. The {WORKFLOW} sends reminders through {EMAIL} or {CHAT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Briefing preparation combined scattered figures, narrative guidance, and context held by the accountant.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable calculations and evidence links handle preparation, while bounded drafting reduces the effort of explaining checked results.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting uncertain rules, surfacing hidden assumptions, and persuading managers to act on uncomfortable advice.
tasks.human_edge: Reading management intent, challenging optimistic assumptions, and explaining consequences in terms that support a real decision.

ambition.what: A monthly financial decision clinic for first-time budget holders.

tasks.altitude: The accountant arrives with checked options and spends more time advising managers. They can offer structured scenario discussions to additional budget holders; spending and policy approval rights stay with their existing holders.

reach.task: Assess budget holders' proposed spending scenarios.
reach.learn: Driver-based forecasting, sensitivity analysis, and how operational choices affect cash and profit.

evidence.claim: Structured financial inputs and document templates can support bounded memo drafting.
That credit-memo capability is adjacent evidence, not proof of reliable regulatory advice.
Financial calculations need independent tie-outs before narrative output is used.

assumptions: The brief uses approved, dated guidance rather than unrestricted generated legal advice.
Decisions are captured in structured notes; recording meetings is unnecessary.
Build ranges cover a small set of recurring management questions.
Access work covers confidential finance data and GDPR requirements; employee consultation is included where national rules require it.
unknowns: The recurring questions and scenario models managers actually use.
Which decisions require formal approval beyond meeting agreement.
Whether additional budget holders have demand and capacity for a decision clinic.
research_questions: Which scenario templates cover recurring questions without hiding material assumptions?
How can dated guidance be linked to each brief and flagged when superseded?
new_work: Check briefing references, assumptions, and guidance dates.
Maintain scenario templates and approved guidance.
Review structured decision notes before actions are assigned.
Resolve overdue actions that automated reminders cannot unblock.

tasks.short: Review company tax accounts and support evidence-based tax examinations.

steps.what: Collect filed returns, tax account statements, ledger detail, and audit correspondence.
Reconcile returns, tax payments, assessments, and ledger balances.
Match supporting documents to audit questions and identify missing evidence.

loop.input: Audit questions, supporting documents, and reconciliation exceptions.
loop.output: Evidence schedule linking questions to document references and extracted fields.
loop.check: Validate document references, dates, identifiers, and totals; reviewer confirms evidence relevance.
loop.stop: One extraction and one retry per document; unreadable or ambiguous evidence enters the missing evidence list.
loop.why_not_simpler: Varied document layouts and narrative audit questions prevent reliable matching by identifiers alone.

steps.what: Discuss transactions and evidence with process owners and the external tax auditor.
Evaluate discrepancies, tax treatment, proposed adjustments, and disputed findings.
Approve and submit the evidence response and stated tax position.
Update the case record, deadlines, and retained evidence.

tasks.design: A controlled case record in the {WORKFLOW} joins {ERP} transactions, approved {GOV_PORTAL} downloads, and evidence in {DOCS}. Deterministic reconciliations identify differences, and a bounded extraction loop builds a referenced evidence schedule. People conduct interviews and determine tax positions; approved responses are assembled from checked fields and submitted through {EMAIL} or the {GOV_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tax evidence spans filings, transactions, correspondence, and source documents, with inconsistent identifiers and restricted portal access.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable reconciliation code and bounded document extraction reduce evidence handling without automating tax conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed facts, tax interpretation, privileged material, cross-border differences, and incomplete historical evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining transaction substance, judging uncertain tax treatment, and defending a position under challenge.

ambition.what: A quarterly tax evidence readiness review before an examination begins.

tasks.altitude: The tax accountant spends less time assembling files and more time resolving discrepancies before deadlines. They can recommend corrections and evidence improvements; statutory examination and adjustment powers remain with the competent authority.

reach.task: Prepare return schedules that reconcile to the ledger and retained evidence.
reach.learn: Return-to-ledger mappings, tax evidence standards, and country-specific filing procedures.

evidence.claim: Document evidence extraction and checking can support reviewed financial examination work.
Tax-return assistance exists with the user retaining responsibility; this does not establish autonomous tax auditing.
A company accountant generally supports an external tax examination rather than exercising statutory summons powers.
Tax reconciliations can use deterministic mappings, arithmetic, and exception rules.

assumptions: For the requested company setting, this task covers reviewing company taxpayer accounts and supporting external examination.
Statutory taxpayer audits and compulsory attendance are outside the company accountant's authority.
On-site meetings replace calls when physical evidence or process observation is needed.
Portal access uses supported interfaces or authorized downloads; unavailable interfaces retain manual intake.
Build ranges cover one entity and tax type, with GDPR review and consultation under national rules where applicable.
unknowns: Whether the role actually belongs to a tax authority or an external audit practice.
Countries, tax types, entities, and examination procedures involved.
Portal access rights and supported export formats.
Who can approve tax positions and external disclosures.
Retention requirements, privilege restrictions, and historical evidence quality.
research_questions: Which national rules govern examination powers, response deadlines, evidence retention, and representation?
Which reconciliation rules distinguish timing differences from substantive tax discrepancies?
Which submission channels provide reliable acknowledgements?
new_work: Review extracted fields and evidence relevance.
Resolve reconciliation exceptions and missing documents.
Maintain tax mappings, deadlines, and approved guidance.
Check disclosure scope and submission receipts.
Maintain retention, access, and deletion controls.

role.altitude: The accountant's week shifts from evidence assembly and repeated comparisons toward control design, investigation, and advice. Professional accountability remains; broader approval rights require an explicit mandate.
reach: Financial risk specialist: connect operational risk indicators to audit coverage.
Business intelligence analyst: define reconciled financial datasets and reporting lineage.
Budget analyst: test operational spending choices against financial scenarios.
Tax preparer: build return schedules with reusable evidence links.
skills_to_grow: Specifying deterministic accounting rules and meaningful reconciliation tests.
Data mapping, lineage, permissions, and interface failure handling.
Reviewing model drafts against original evidence.
Scenario analysis and clear management advice.
Control design, auditor independence, GDPR, and applicable national rules.
role.ambitious_version: Build a reusable finance assurance service that offers monthly audit coverage reviews, a control sandbox, budget-holder decision clinics, and quarterly tax evidence readiness reviews.
